proof_attempt_summary: Original marked-likelihood packet converses and certified procedures gave reviewed matched MSE orders n^(-8/13) versus n^(-2/3), honest lengths n^(-4/13) versus n^(-1/3), and a uniform-null disclosure separation. D0 math review and independent validity inspection found no concrete mathematical defect, but the fixed benchmark was capped at subfield below the field floor, with impractical constants and unresolved accepted-bank comparator and stale-prose debt. No Lean formalization, practical implementation, or application was delivered; a future re-raise requires a materially stronger contribution.
tldr: A public smooth intervention can have a nonregular value when its treatment density must be learned through measurement error. The Bernoulli regression law at the latent dose is primitive; a specified compatible uniform-variable process gives the exogenous intervention its causal interpretation. The focal object is the precision price of disclosing both treatment densities while leaving the causal target and positive Lipschitz parent unchanged. The four global minimax squared-risk and honest-length orders, including possible logarithms, are determined in the original binary marked Laplace experiment. A second comparison asks how full-parent honesty behaves at the uniform causal null. Compact inverse packets and second-order correction provide concrete starting moves; total finite-sample certification is the principal open obligation. Classical inverse-functional rates and higher-order density-information comparisons are credited rather than presented as new.
gap: Butucea (2007) treats unmarked quadratic convolution functionals, Pensky (2017) fixes linear inverse weights, and Robins and coauthors (2008) already compares nuisance-density information in direct-data functionals. The inspected results do not settle all four precision objects for the fixed \(q\)-intervention on the identical rough marked-Laplace parent, or its uniform-null honest-length comparison.
fill: Original-record testing must keep both marks and use identical disclosed densities within each supplied pair. Attainment must certify constrained pilots, shared-record covariance, bias, failure events and arithmetic in one finite-sample interval. The prospective consumer is the NHANES-I saturated-fat/breast-cancer causal-dose analysis and its MATLAB implementation by Huang and Zhang; their Gaussian-error application is not represented as satisfying the present benchmark.
